title: THE SORRY
content:
Does it even matters to you?

Does the sorry matters when I cried till death?
Does the sorry matters when I needed you?
Does the sorry matters when the pain that you gave was intentional?
Does the sorry matters when your words hurted me more than any serious wound?
Does the sorry matters when I was dying to talk to you and you did not?
Does the sorry matters when I looked into your eyes and they still lied?
Does the sorry matters when you said you won't but you did it again?
Does the sorry matters when my ears wanted to hear you but you did not utter a single word?
Does the sorry matters when I said no and you still did the same?
Does the sorry matters when I was going through your pain and I needed only you?
A sorry might be just a word for you but for me it is the separation between us!

title: I DON'T LOVE YOU ANYMORE
content:
Maybe just for the sake of saying!

I know I shouldn't recall those days when you loved me,
But each second reminds me of those moments that we had together.
I know a lot has changed between us,
But they say love doesn't change when it is true.

I still remember those morning texts,
I still remember those eyes which looked for me(only me) every second.
I still remember those chilly nights with a warmness of your virtual presence.

Sometimes discussing and understanding the situation can fix a lot,
But again it is thing that both of us should try doing so,
Not everytime one sided effort's can make a relationship work.

I think begging for your love isn't the way to have you,
But all I know is that maybe I was wrong and so were you at times
But the difference is that I always tried to understand you and you did not even like to talk to me.

Maybe I wasn't asking for more,
But all I know is that I can't love you anymore!
Harder I cried and to my best I tried,
But maybe it isn't meant to be,
The love that was once between you and me!

title: HIS PLACE, HIS GRACE! 🌸
content:
Adorable in the most beautiful ways! ✨

The sky is blue, but a tint of pink makes it look so beautiful,
The roses are glowing ,but the water droplets on it making it more wonderful.
The water in the river making its way through those mountainous mountain's,
The flora and fauna living their lives in the most adorable ways.
The glaciers, The volcanoes,
The breathtaking scenerios.
The shining sun, the changing seasons,
Each being loved for different reasons.
The stars in the sky,
The picturesque moon up above so high.
The creatures on this earth make it a lovely place,
He has just carved out every thing in the most adorable ways.
And that is why everyone says,
Each and everything here is just his grace.

title: YOUR PRESENCE IS MY LIFE'S PREETIEST ESSENCE! 🤍
content:
In your eyes lies the beauty of whole universe,
In your smile I feel the peace that could calm my soul for years.
Your presence adds charm to my existence,
Your sweet talks and with you those late night walks
Are those moments which I always dreamt of.
When I look at you, I realise the actual meaning of togetherness,
With you it's just simple,
No fear and no stress.
Dancing with you in the rain,
Sharing to you even the tiniest part of my pain.
I actually figured out that sometimes it is just about those beautiful moments,
Filled with you me and those small but happy involvements.
Sometimes all what I wish for is just you,
My day in definately incomplete without talking to you.
Maybe your existence is like the reason to my existence
Because you are just like the blessing in disguise to me at once.

title: THE UNSAID WORDS!
content:
Feelings never felt so beautiful!

The cloudy sky, filled with the fragrance of wet sand,
The view, you and the beautiful us walking hand in hand.
You tell me that I look like a little blooming flower,
But how can I tell you that this happiness is the result of the love that you shower.
You ask me what I like,
But how can I reply,'The person standing by my side.'
You ask me what makes me happy,
But how can I say that it's those small moments when it's only you and me.
You ask me what I don't like,
But how can I reply to it as our fights.
You ask me what has a deeper impact on me,
But how can I tell that it's those moments when destiny separates you and me.
Thoughts and thoughts running across my mind,
To any of your questions a perfect answer I could not find.
Maybe a dream, maybe a wish, maybe a prayer.
Everytime I look at you I want you to be mine forever!

title: SHE HAD HE
content:
She looked beautiful, so he kept admiring.
She looked stressed, so he became her stress reliever.
She wanted to live like a child, so he started acting kiddish.
She wanted to eat, so he cooked.
She wanted to dance, so he took a chance.
She wanted to explore, so he took her for a tour.
She wanted to cry, he was the one dying inside.
She wanted to go for a walk, he made it even more special with his talk.
She would love getting pictured, so he kept on capturing her.
She wasn't perfect, but he was the one calling her a perfectionist.
She wanted to live every little moment, he was the one making them the longest.
She was the one dreaming and he was the one making it true.
She just wished for a life, but he was the one living it.
She became a complete she, because she had he.

title: PEOPLE
content:
Can they define you?

Someone said you aren't focused,
Someone said this isn't your thing,
Someone said you don't know it,
Someone said that you aren't confident,
Someone said you aren't sure,
Someone said you can't do it,
Someone said better luck next time,
Someone said it will be difficult,
Someone said it will get complicated,
Someone said you aren't perfect,
Someone said you aren't made for it,
But, no one said you can do it.
This is what people actually are,
They judge you for what you are,
But believe in yourself, believe in what you do,
Ultimately it's your opinion that defines you.

title: BEGINNING OF THE END
content:
He was the light of her life,
She is now a coward in the dark.
He made her learn to live without people,
She is now learning to live without him.
He was the one screaming loudest on her achievements,
She prefers to stay silent on her success now.
He was the one teaching her patience,
She is now patiently accepting all what he did.
He was the reason for her happiness,
She is now faking it every moment.
He was the one to care for her,
She doesn't even bother about herself now.
He loved her like nobody could,
She is now hating to love.
He did something that nobody could,
And she is now struggling to even do something that she could.
He did all that he wanted,
And she got the end that she never wanted.

title: FROM NOTHING TO EVERYTHING
content:
When I first talked to you,
It felt like nothing new.
When I started understanding you,
It felt like a happy little dream come true.
When I started sharing myself with you,
I could get this comfortable, I never knew.
When I first met you,
I found a person turning into home very true.
When I first had a fight with you,
The effect of attachment felt so true.
When I first realised what a person can do to you,
I looked in the mirror and it said, it has already happened to you.
When you first asked me'What is happiness for you?'
The only answer I wanted to give was 'You.'
Maybe you would never know what you are to me,
Maybe I won't even tell you how much you mean to me,
But the only thing, the only wish I have is to live every little moment which only has you and me.

title: A HUMAN OR A BLESSING?
content:
I was like a paper and you were the writer,
You wrote my life the way no one could ever.
I was like an old magazine lying on a shelf,
You made me realise my worth which I would have never done myself.
I was just like a glass of water,
You were the one to tell me how much to you I matter.
I was just like an ordinary star in the whole sky,
You were the only one with the immense love in your eye.
I was just like a poem unread,
You read my each word like no one could ever have.
I was like a wish unsaid,
You were the one to fulfill that.
I was just a person who never knew how beautiful life could be,
You were the one to bring everything so gracefully out of me.
I might thank god for gifting me this life,
But I would be forever grateful to him for the blessing as you in my life.

title: LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT OR THE VIEW OF EYESIGHT
content:
When a true lover turns into a poet 

I never believed in love at first sight,
Until I witnessed it through my eyesight.
I never believed in the concept of missing someone,
Until I found you to be the one.
I never knew what efforts are,
Until I saw you putting them even when you were way too far.
I never understood what little things can do to a person,
Until you did them and I found you to be a version of a sweet person.
I never thought how beautiful it would be to be in true love,
Until I found myself doing everything to keep you beside me, My love.

title: AND IF WORDS COULD WRITE FATE ✨
content:
If words could write fate,
Mine would definitely be great.
The start would be the end,
The word you from the beginning till the end.
With a sprinkle of love,
With a pinch of happiness.
With nothing more, nothing less,
With the only blessing as you he could bless.
Little in itself but everything for me,
A fate with the element termed 'we.'
And if words could write fate,
Less than a minute it would take.
To pen down you as my whole fate,
Definitely the shortest one written till date.

title: A STAR THAT EVEN I OWNED ✨
content:
Stars in the sky, every night I count,
In memory of you, no doubt.
Staring at each one with hope,
One day would count with you, though ain't any scope.
Reflection of the moon's light, lights up the sky every night,
Resembling you by my side.
Something about the dark sky makes me feel alone,
But once there was a star that I called my own.

title: UNSEEN BLESSINGS ✨
content:
You are blessed with a blessing
That someone once prayed for.

You are loved with love
That someone always begged for.

You are giving up on something
That someone is putting efforts for.

You are breaking a relation
That someone was crying for.

You are hating a person,
That someone could have died for.

You are living a life,
That someone always dreamt for.

title: LOVE BETWEEN LINES 💌
content:
If not confessed, what means love?
If not valued, what means love?
If not understood, what means love?
If not cherished, what means love?
If not respected, what means love?
If not trusted, what means love?
If not protected, what means love?
If not nurtured, what means love?
If not cared for, what means love?
But what if never addressed?
Was it even love?

title: WHEN LOVE AND LOSS LOOKS ALIKE 🌙
content:
Someone chose to smoke,
Someone chose to love,
One kills slowly,
The other slowly kills.

Someone chose to stay,
Someone chose to leave,
One died waiting,
The other waiting to die.

Someone chose to be loved,
Someone chose to love,
One couldn't value,
The other never valued.

Someone chose to be the first,
Someone chose to be the last,
One cried waiting,
The other waiting to cry.

Someone chose to be the one,
Someone chose to be at least the one,
And one could never decide,
Who could be the actual one.

title: HALFWAY HOME 🌙
content:
I walked out and never looked back,
From the place to my idiom 'take me back'.
My heart never ached so hard,
Hands numb, eyes crying loud.
Yet the beauty in pain felt so beautiful,
I could have written a poem, so soulful.
The art of hiding the feeling,
Skilled in the pain I was concealing.
Never realised home was not just a place,
It was halfway love, halfway grace.

title: IMPOSSIBILITIES OF US
content:
I see the sun as you filled with love for me,
But then I realise how far it is for mine to be.
The stars remind me of the good times we once shared,
Ironically, they are the only times I cannot forget.
Maybe the love was never meant,
But the art of loving you is my sweetest torment.
I am in love with the impossibilities of us,
A part of me still believes in us.

title: THE WHIRLPOOL OF LOVE 🌪️
content:
In the eyes of love, even the hate is adored,
Making its way through tears never cured.
The pain in smile, the gain in loss,
The irony of love won the toss.
Everything at the verge of a sinking ship,
Only the dive of love could flip the script.
The game of words, oh so strong,
Turned even the right one into the wrong.
The beauty of love wrapped in whirlpool of hate,
The end of all, just a term 'taken for granted.'

title: LOSERS IN LOVE 🌙
content:
Little hope of being loved,
Left a scar that screamed unloved.
Heart filled with veins of failure,
Eyes held the look of the end, broken, a lost sailor.
But the admiration of those admiring love,
The sole thought, why so unlucky in love?
But the unanswered love never termed rhetorical,
A loser in love, yet finding it magical.

title: REMEMBER WE NEVER SAID GOODBYE🌙
content:
Someone so radiant in those darkest nights,
Never found again after those unhinged fights.
Maybe a reason, maybe a want,
But It wasn't you who broke the bond.
Good times, Sweet memories,
A complete lane of never ending stories.
A question unanswered, a reason never said,
Marked the beginning of the end.
Maybe you tried, maybe you stayed,
Remember people go but memories don't fade.
A chance never missed, a promise always kept,
But circumstances so horrid, even a goodbye made one wept.

title: MAYBE YOU'LL FIND A BETTER YOU ✨
content:
With hope in the heart and faith in god,
With confidence in work and belief in yourself,
Maybe you will find a better you.

With struggle in accepting,
With ease in understanding,
Maybe you will find a better you.

With self realisation,
With self respect and with self efficacy,
Maybe you will find a better you.

With dependency on none,
With a little twist and turn,
Maybe you will find a better you.

With charm on face,
With little negotiation in facing the race,
Maybe you will find a better you.

With dedication in every task,
With a thought of never missing out,
Maybe you will find a better you.

With expectations from yourself and acceptance about others,
With the support of no one but self motivation,
One day you'll definitely find a better you.
